analysis_md:
$$
x'_t\bigg|_{t=\frac{1}{2}}=\sqrt{5}t^2\bigg|_{t=\frac{1}{2}}=\frac{\sqrt{5}}{4},\quad
y'_t\bigg|_{t=\frac{1}{2}}=4t^3=\frac{1}{2},\quad
z'_t\bigg|_{t=\frac{1}{2}}=2t-1=0,
$$

\sin\varphi=\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{\sqrt{\frac{9}{16}}}=\frac{2}{3},
$$
